title_or_table: OpenFEC API, financial totals for PACs and party committees, 2023 to 2024 election cycle, sorted by independent expenditures (top 25)
observation_period: Two-year election cycle 2023 to 2024 (January 1, 2023 to December 31, 2024)
universe_or_base: Political action committees and party committees registered with the FEC (9688 in the cycle), ranked by the independent expenditures their reports total
unit: dollars, nominal, as the FEC's processed totals give them
vintage: FEC processed data as served on November 11, 2026
qualification: Independent expenditures are spending for or against candidates made without coordinating with them; the totals count spending for and against together and leave out groups that are not political committees (filers of Form 5, such as some nonprofits). Money moved between committees is counted where it was spent. The FEC records no party for a PAC, so the register names each committee as the FEC lists it

committee_name.description: committee name as the FEC lists it

coverage_end_date.description: last day covered by the committee's reports

printed_source_line: Source: Federal Election Commission, financial totals for PACs and party committees, independent expenditures, 2023 to 2024 cycle, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Spending for and against candidates together; groups that are not political committees are not included.
